messages:
Bhai, website ka haal kharab hai — lekin sahi raste pe hai.

- 87 products, lekin sabke description aur title pe violation hai. 0 clean.
- 19 product descriptions abhi pending rewrite ke liye. 82 apply ho chuke.
- Backup 6+ days purana hai — warning hai, abhi backup chalao ya toh crash ho jayega.
- Aaj ₹0 sales, month bhi ₹0. Kuch bhi nahi chal raha.
- Security scan last 2026 mein hua? 🤨 — ye date galat hai, scan actually hua ya nahi? Check karun?
- Content queue khali hai. Media aur developer idle hain — kaam hai, kaun karega?

**Action?**  
Aaj hi backup chalwa du? Aur 19 pending product rewrites ko priority du?  
Bata, main seedha shuru kar deta hoon.
